SMS PROGRAM TERMS AND CONSENT

Program name: Ridgeback Outfitters Alerts
Program description: order updates, restock alerts, and promotional offers

By entering your mobile number and selecting "Sign up for texts," you consent to receive recurring automated marketing text messages from Ridgeback Outfitters, Inc. at the number you provide. Consent is not a condition of any purchase.

Message frequency varies, and averages 4 messages per month. Message and data rates may apply.

Reply STOP to any message to cancel. After you send STOP we will send one message confirming your cancellation, and you will receive no further messages unless you sign up again. Reply HELP for help, or contact us at support@ridgebackoutfitters.com or (208) 555-0182.

Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

We do not sell or rent your mobile number to third parties. We share it with our messaging service provider solely to deliver the messages you asked for. See our Privacy Policy at ridgebackoutfitters.com/privacy for how we handle your information.

You may also cancel by emailing support@ridgebackoutfitters.com with the number to be removed.

Effective: March 1, 2026.
